item.title: Bridges & Brunch with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Mon Sep 7 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Experience a relaxing morning ride through the back roads of Amish Country in Lancaster County, PA. Along the way to a 19th century covered bridge, enjoy the scenery of rolling hills, breathtaking views, and our Amish neighbors going about their daily routines. Itinerary Duration: 1.5-2 hours Some of our past tours have included:
A guided tour of one of Lancaster County’s most beautiful covered bridges An opportunity for a close up of daily life in Amish Country $10 dining voucher to one of two of Strasburg’s favorites brunch spots, Casey Jones’ Restaurant and Speckled Hen*
And each trip is unique, so you never know what we might have in store for you! *Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that some of the food offerings on the tour may not be considered ‘Kosher.’ We apologize for any inconvenience.
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.description:

item.title: CoffeeTue- IC Houston Cafe (22R) RSVP Required — Tue Sep 8, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup Ride Leader: Show-and-Go Ride Sweep: (volunteer to sweep!)
CoffeeTue rides: • A rotating start location, not a school • A predetermined route • 25+/- mile routes • 12 to 14 and 14 to 17 mph average pace • “short” stop for refreshment/coffee mid-route at [The Houston Run Cafe](https://www.thehoustonruncafe.com/)
Like an All Class Ride, CoffeeTue does not have a single pace. There will be multiple regroup points during the ride. The CoffeeTue rides are social rides, but cyclists are not expected to stay in one group. Cyclists may pedal at their own comfortable paces. A planned stop to regroup is recommended. Please be supportive of the other cyclists to avoid anyone biking alone or being dropped off the back of the last group. **Be Safe, Have Fun, and Ride Together**
Click for [Ride with GPS](https://routes.lancasterbikeclub.net/cue/__trashed/)

item.title: Wednesday Morning's Breakfast Rides Casual Pace Variable Distance RSVP Required — Wed Sep 9, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup It's September and time to change our breakfast rides to 9am... Every Wednesday morning...Ride and eat Yummy breakfast together.
Please do not go on this ride unless you will ride at a casual pace and stay with the group . We will meet to ride to breakfast at a casual pace. After eating some may split up with some returning to the start and others going longer and faster.
Helmets are mandatory; No ear buds or audible music playing devices. Please bring water, and a basic repair kit (spare tube, tire levers, pump/CO2 inflator).
To eliminate passing around a pen and paper waiver, we encourage LBC Club membership and Meetup RSVP below to join this ride. RSVP also allows us to contact you after the ride if needed. If you do not RSVP you are not covered by the club excess accident insurance policy; only club members who RSVP are covered. Being on Meetup does not mean you are a club member. Join here- https://www.lancasterbikeclub.net/content.aspx?page_
